name: Fat Snare
notes:
snareFatSeed: the fat-bottom snare retuned for CRACK (2026-09-30, picked by
ear as "pretty fire"). Every shipped snare measured weak against real snare
recordings at equal peak — the app plays each one at the loudness cap, so
what counts is energy density, not peak: the 1-5 kHz crack over 5-50 ms sat
4-9 dB under the recordings (median -17.5 dB at peak 1), and the body under a
0 ms fizzy spike. Fitted against the median of nine real snares (1/3-octave x
time map + an early-loudness floor + a crack floor + a >7 kHz fizz ceiling):
the wire bands move DOWN (snare_tune 0.55 -> 0.41 puts the fixed 1.8/3.2/4.5
kHz bands at ~0.7/1.3/1.8 kHz), the wires come up and the body drives harder
into the voice's soft-saturation — denser, like a compressed recorded snare.
Crack -21 -> -17 dB, early RMS -10.5 -> -6 dB.
